model_output.rationale: Line 0 (97750:GP) denied CO-97 + N20 — payer bundled the physical performance test into the same-day 97140 manual therapy services. No separate-session modifier was billed. Chart note explicitly logs 97750 as a distinct session with its own timed interval, target region, and goal. CARC 97 notes "modifier needs documented criteria"; that documentation exists. Commercial plan (CI), so corrected claim frequency 7 + REF*F8 resolves it. Lines 1–3 (97140 x3) are paid; CO-45 and PR-2 are contractual write-off and coinsurance — routine AR, not denials.

root_cause.explanation: 97750 denied CO-97 + N20 alongside same-date 97140 services; no separate-session modifier (59/XS) was appended. Chart documents 97750 as a distinct session with separate timing, target region, and goal.

next_action.detail: Add modifier 59 (or XS) to the 97750:GP line only. Send replacement claim, CLM05-3=7, REF*F8=2419935721000 (CLP07). Include all four original lines. Retain chart note documenting the separate session as supporting documentation.
